Blinky 1.5.46

  • 圆环中的小机器人改为 Open Bot Avatar 的形象。 在「设置 → 供应商」中打开某个账号的「外观」，将「小机器人形象」设为 23 种形象之一或「自动」；原来的「小机器人性格」和「小机器人外形」已经去掉。
  • 按 token 计费的 Copilot 席位会保留已发放的高级请求额度。 Business 席位把已经发放的额度标成没有额度时，这份额度仍会显示。感谢 @lexleizou 贡献。
  • 已经关闭的 WAL 对话数据库仍会被读取。 「Token 消耗」和活动标记会以不可变方式打开这种数据库，因此进程关闭后的对话仍然计入。#117
  • Antigravity 2.34 不会让圆环停在上一次的读数。 语言服务器的命令行没有 --csrf_token 时，Blinky 改为读取该进程环境中的 ANTIGRAVITY_SERVER_CSRF_TOKEN。#116

Blinky 1.5.46

  • The robot in the ring is drawn from Open Bot Avatar. Under Settings → Providers, open an account's Appearance and set Robot figure to one of 23 figures or to Automatic; Robot personality and Robot shape are gone.
  • A token-billed Copilot seat keeps its issued premium allowance. A Business seat that reports an allowance it did issue as no quota now shows that allowance. Thanks to @lexleizou for the contribution.
  • A closed WAL conversation database is still read. Token spend and the activity mark open that database as immutable, so a conversation still counts after its process has closed it. #117
  • Antigravity 2.34 does not leave the ring on its last reading. When the language server's command line has no --csrf_token, Blinky reads ANTIGRAVITY_SERVER_CSRF_TOKEN from that process. #116
